mapper.sql: co.id AS id, co.code AS code, co.name AS name, co.amount AS amount, co.expected_date AS expectedDate, cod.crm_pipeline_setting_id AS pipelineId, cps.description AS pipelineName, cod.crm_opportunity_stag_id AS stageId, cos.name AS stageName, cod.probability AS probability, co.crm_opportunity_source_id AS sourceId, crm_opportunity_sources.name AS sourceName, co.customer_id AS organizationId, org.name AS organizationName, co.lead_id AS LeadId, lead.name AS LeadName, co.responsibility_id AS responsibilityId, CONCAT(responsibility.first_name, ' ', responsibility.last_name) AS responsibilityName, co.division_id AS divisionId, customer_lead_divisions.title AS divisionName, co.customer_contact_id AS contactId, customer_contacts.contact_name AS contactName, co.quotation_id AS quotationId, quotations.quotation_code AS quotationNo, co.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, orders.order_code AS salesOrderNo, co.description AS description, co.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, co.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM crm_opportunities AS co LEFT JOIN crm_opportunity_details AS cod ON cod.crm_opportunity_id = co.id AND cod.is_active = 1 AND cod.is_convert = 0 LEFT JOIN crm_pipeline_settings AS cps ON cps.id = cod.crm_pipeline_setting_id LEFT JOIN crm_opportunity_stags AS cos ON cos.id = cod.crm_opportunity_stag_id LEFT JOIN crm_opportunity_sources ON crm_opportunity_sources.id = co.crm_opportunity_source_id LEFT JOIN customers AS org ON org.id = co.customer_id LEFT JOIN customers AS lead ON lead.id = co.lead_id LEFT JOIN customer_contacts ON customer_contacts.id = co.customer_contact_id LEFT JOIN customer_lead_divisions ON customer_lead_divisions.id = co.division_id LEFT JOIN quotations ON quotations.id = co.quotation_id LEFT JOIN orders ON orders.id = co.sales_order_id LEFT JOIN users AS responsibility ON responsibility.id = co.responsibility_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = co.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = co.modified_by
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_opportunities SET name = #{opportunity.name}, amount = #{opportunity.amount}, expected_date = #{opportunity.expectedDate}, responsibility_id = #{opportunity.responsibilityId}, crm_opportunity_source_id = #{opportunity.sourceId}, division_id = #{opportunity.divisionId}, customer_contact_id = #{opportunity.customerContactId}, quotation_id = #{opportunity.quotationId}, sales_order_id = #{opportunity.salesOrderId}, description = #{opportunity.description}, customer_id = #{opportunity.customerId}, lead_id = #{opportunity.leadId}, employee_id = #{opportunity.employeeId}, vendor_id = #{opportunity.vendorId}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{opportunity.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{opportunity.id} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE crm_opportunities SET is_active = 2, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_opportunity_details ( crm_opportunity_id, crm_pipeline_setting_id, crm_opportunity_stag_id, probability, created, created_by, is_active, is_convert ) VALUES ( #{detail.opportunityId}, #{detail.pipelineId}, #{detail.stageId}, #{detail.probability}, NOW(), #{detail.createdBy}, #{detail.isActive}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT type FROM crm_opportunity_sources WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = #{sourceId}
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_opportunities SET code = #{code} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT cod.id AS id, cod.crm_pipeline_setting_id AS pipelineId, cod.crm_opportunity_stag_id AS stageId, cos.name AS stageName, cod.probability AS probability, cod.description AS description FROM crm_opportunity_details AS cod LEFT JOIN crm_opportunity_stags AS cos ON cos.id = cod.crm_opportunity_stag_id WHERE cod.crm_opportunity_id = #{opportunityId} AND cod.is_active = 1 AND cod.is_convert = 0 ORDER BY cod.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT coa.id AS id, coa.name AS name, CASE WHEN activeActivity.crm_opportunity_activity_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS selected FROM crm_opportunity_activities AS coa LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT crm_opportunity_activity_id FROM crm_opportunity_activity_details WHERE crm_opportunity_id = #{opportunityId} AND is_active = 1 ) AS activeActivity ON activeActivity.crm_opportunity_activity_id = coa.id WHERE coa.is_active = 1 AND coa.id IN ( SELECT crm_opportunity_activity_id FROM crm_opportunity_stag_activities WHERE crm_pipeline_setting_id = #{pipelineId} AND crm_opportunity_stag_id = #{stageId} ) AND coa.id IN ( SELECT crm_opportunity_activity_id FROM crm_opportunity_activity_egroups WHERE egroup_id IN ( SELECT egroup_id FROM employee_egroups WHERE employee_id IN (SELECT id FROM employees WHERE user_id = #{userId}) ) ) ORDER BY coa.id ASC

SELECT cot.id AS id, cot.name AS name, cot.crm_opportunity_activity_id AS activityId, coa.name AS activityName, CASE WHEN activeTask.crm_opportunity_task_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS selected FROM crm_opportunity_tasks AS cot INNER JOIN crm_opportunity_activities AS coa ON coa.id = cot.crm_opportunity_activity_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT crm_opportunity_task_id FROM crm_opportunity_task_details WHERE crm_opportunity_id = #{opportunityId} AND is_active = 1 ) AS activeTask ON activeTask.crm_opportunity_task_id = cot.id WHERE cot.is_active = 1 AND coa.id IN ( SELECT crm_opportunity_activity_id FROM crm_opportunity_stag_activities WHERE crm_pipeline_setting_id = #{pipelineId} AND crm_opportunity_stag_id = #{stageId} ) ORDER BY coa.id ASC, cot.crm_opportunity_activity_id ASC, cot.id ASC

SELECT nextStage.crm_opportunity_stag_id AS stageId, cos.name AS stageName, nextStage.percent AS percent FROM crm_pipeline_setting_stags AS currentStage INNER JOIN crm_pipeline_setting_stags AS nextStage ON nextStage.crm_pipeline_setting_id = currentStage.crm_pipeline_setting_id AND nextStage.ordering = currentStage.ordering + 1 LEFT JOIN crm_opportunity_stags AS cos ON cos.id = nextStage.crm_opportunity_stag_id WHERE currentStage.crm_pipeline_setting_id = #{pipelineId} AND currentStage.crm_opportunity_stag_id = #{stageId} LIMIT 1

SELECT previousStage.crm_opportunity_stag_id AS stageId, cos.name AS stageName, previousStage.percent AS percent FROM crm_pipeline_setting_stags AS currentStage INNER JOIN crm_pipeline_setting_stags AS previousStage ON previousStage.crm_pipeline_setting_id = currentStage.crm_pipeline_setting_id AND previousStage.ordering = currentStage.ordering - 1 LEFT JOIN crm_opportunity_stags AS cos ON cos.id = previousStage.crm_opportunity_stag_id WHERE currentStage.crm_pipeline_setting_id = #{pipelineId} AND currentStage.crm_opportunity_stag_id = #{stageId} LIMIT 1

SELECT cpss.crm_opportunity_stag_id AS stageId, cos.name AS stageName, cpss.percent AS percent FROM crm_pipeline_setting_stags AS cpss LEFT JOIN crm_opportunity_stags AS cos ON cos.id = cpss.crm_opportunity_stag_id WHERE cpss.crm_pipeline_setting_id = #{pipelineId} AND cpss.crm_opportunity_stag_id = #{stageId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id AS id, quotation_code AS code, customer_id AS customerId, customer_contact_id AS customerContactId, total_amount AS totalAmount, discount AS discount, total_vat AS totalVat FROM quotations WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id AS id, order_code AS code, customer_id AS customerId, customer_contact_id AS customerContactId, total_amount AS totalAmount, discount AS discount, total_vat AS totalVat FROM orders WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

mapper.update: UPDATE crm_opportunity_activity_details SET is_active = 2 WHERE crm_opportunity_id = #{opportunityId} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE crm_opportunity_task_details SET is_active = 2 WHERE crm_opportunity_id = #{opportunityId} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_opportunity_activity_details ( crm_opportunity_id, crm_opportunity_stag_id, crm_opportunity_activity_id, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{opportunityId}, #{stageId}, #{activityId}, NOW(), #{userId}, 1 )

INSERT INTO crm_opportunity_task_details ( crm_opportunity_id, crm_opportunity_stag_id, crm_opportunity_task_id, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{opportunityId}, #{stageId}, #{taskId}, NOW(), #{userId}, 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT name FROM crm_opportunity_activities WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT name FROM crm_opportunity_tasks WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_opportunity_details SET is_convert = 1, converted = NOW(), converted_by = #{userId}, is_skip = 1, skipped = NOW(), skipped_by = #{userId} WHERE crm_opportunity_id = #{opportunityId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM crm_opportunity_details WHERE crm_opportunity_id = #{opportunityId} AND crm_opportunity_stag_id = #{stageId} AND is_active = 1 AND is_convert = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_opportunity_logs ( crm_opportunity_id, type, status, description, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{opportunityId}, #{type}, #{status}, #{description}, NOW(), #{userId} )
mapper.select: SELECT logData.id AS id, logData.type AS type, logData.status AS status, logData.statusName AS statusName, CONCAT(IFNULL(logData.createdBy, ''), ': ', logData.statusName) AS title, logData.description AS description, logData.borderColor AS borderColor, logData.created AS created, logData.createdBy AS createdBy FROM ( SELECT col.id AS id, col.type AS type, col.status AS status, CASE col.type WHEN 1 THEN CASE WHEN col.status = 1 THEN 'Created New' ELSE 'Update' END WHEN 2 THEN 'Created Activity New' WHEN 3 THEN 'Created Task New' WHEN 4 THEN 'Back Stage' WHEN 5 THEN 'Skip Stage' WHEN 6 THEN 'Save Stage' ELSE '' END AS statusName, col.description AS description, CASE col.type WHEN 1 THEN 'border-left: 3px solid #5c88f7;' WHEN 2 THEN 'border-left: 3px solid #1df541;' WHEN 3 THEN 'border-left: 3px solid #f2ee0f;' WHEN 4 THEN 'border-left: 3px solid #fc0324;' WHEN 5 THEN 'border-left: 3px solid #ffa203;' WHEN 6 THEN 'border-left: 3px solid #5c88f7;' ELSE '' END AS borderColor, DATE_FORMAT(col.created, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%i:%s') AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy FROM crm_opportunity_logs AS col LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = col.created_by WHERE col.crm_opportunity_id = #{opportunityId} ) AS logData ORDER BY logData.id DESC
